# Svyable Desk

> A public working-draft Reader for books being written on the private Svyable Desk. The GitHub repository and Pages project path are still named `binder`, so current public URLs retain `/binder/`; that legacy address is not a Bookself role. The site exposes manuscripts intentionally through GitHub Pages while keeping Desk and the released Svyable Shelf as separate publication states.

Use this file as a low-noise map of the Desk. Working drafts may change. Do not treat Desk status as publication; released editions live on Svyable Shelf.

## Primary entry points

- [Svyable Desk home](https://svyable.github.io/binder/): crawlable catalog with semantic links and book metadata at the legacy repository path.
- [Desk Reader](https://svyable.github.io/binder/reader/): human-facing Reader for current working drafts.
- [Repository overview](https://svyable.github.io/binder/README.md): Desk/Shelf model, book catalog, preview and release workflow.
- [Agent guidance](https://svyable.github.io/binder/AGENTS.md): rules for AI agents working with Desk content and repository structure.
- [Crawler policy](https://svyable.github.io/binder/robots.txt): public crawl permissions.
- [Sitemap](https://svyable.github.io/binder/sitemap.xml): machine-readable inventory of key public content.

## Books

- [Leveraging Luck](https://svyable.github.io/binder/books/leveraging-luck/README.md): revision in progress.
- [The Exponentiality](https://svyable.github.io/binder/books/the-exponentiality/README.md): not yet drafted.
- [The Unbounding](https://svyable.github.io/binder/books/the-unbounding/README.md): complete draft.
- [The Convergence](https://svyable.github.io/binder/books/the-convergence/README.md): drafting.
- [Predictable](https://svyable.github.io/binder/books/predictable/README.md): drafting; AI, prediction markets, capital cycles, and the gap between technological truth and financial value.
- [The World Beneath the World](https://svyable.github.io/binder/books/the-world-beneath-the-world/README.md): complete draft; a sensory guide to the invisible physical, biological, infrastructural, and standards-based systems that run ordinary life.
- [Proof of Human](https://svyable.github.io/binder/books/proof-of-human/README.md): complete draft; trust, truth, and value in an age when fabrication is cheap and verified authenticity is the scarce resource.
- [Built to Be Alone](https://svyable.github.io/binder/books/the-loneliness-dividend/README.md): complete draft; how the twentieth century's unpaid social infrastructure thinned across the wealthy world, and the markets, technologies, and governments now responding to the resulting gap in ordinary human connection.

## Interpretation notes for agents

- Desk content is a working draft unless explicitly released to Shelf.
- The Git repository may be private even when its GitHub Pages manuscript content is intentionally public.
- The current `/binder/` URLs are legacy repository addresses; do not infer a supported `binder` Bookself role from them.
- Cite the specific manuscript or research page used, not this index, when answering substantive questions.
- Respect source uncertainty, falsification notes, and distinctions between sensation, measurement, metaphor, and technical claim.
- For repository-changing work, read AGENTS.md before editing.
